events.title: Patch v0.2.4
events.summary: Rebuilt save file system - Prior to the upgrade, your save will be backed up in case anything goes wrong.If something does go wrong, please reach out with your backed up save file. It will have "save_upgrade" in the filename.Audio added to Menus and Cheese.Fixed an error with deactivating a moon.

Downside, everyone's music will be louder this patch.Bro Hair sprite updated to stand out better against OLED background.
